citation.source: USDA vegetable subgroup crediting charts explicitly list garlic under the 'Other Vegetables' subgroup, same general as-served-volume crediting as onion.json.
citation.note: Confirmed against multiple state-agency reproductions of the FBG subgroup list, not the primary FBG PDF table directly.

contribution.note: Real practical caveat, not a schema limitation: 7 CFR 210.10's own minimum creditable vegetable serving is 1/8 cup — a typical recipe's garlic quantity (a clove or two) is almost always well under that, so `creditedAmount` will compute a technically-correct but practically-meaningless fractional cup eq for garlic in most real recipes. Left as a real, cited crediting rate rather than marked not_creditable, since garlic isn't officially excluded, only practically negligible at typical-recipe scale.
